receipt.stdout:
Usage: agentprof [options] [command]

Local agent profiling. Development build; bounded scan and selected-source
stats/insights. Selected-source offline reports are supported; global
aggregation is pending.

Options:
  -V, --version              output the version number
  --json                     emit structured results and errors
  --data-dir <directory>     override local private data directory
  --codex-root <directory>   replace Codex input roots (repeatable) (default:
                             [])
  --claude-root <directory>  replace Claude input roots (repeatable) (default:
                             [])
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  scan [options]             Collect explicit --codex-root/--claude-root inputs
                             only (at least one required)
  stats [options]            Read one stored source prefix or list up to 64
                             sources (read-only)
  insights [options]         Read Slow Tool evidence from one stored source
                             prefix (read-only)
  patterns [options]         Inspect one stored source's observed validation
                             cycles and evidence-gated patterns
  history [options]          Reconcile explicit stored sources and show dated
                             native-call intervals (read-only)
  report [options]           Write a new offline HTML report from one stored
                             source or explicit input file
  open <file>                Request the system opener for one explicitly
                             trusted local HTML file
  help [command]             display help for command
